# MagicBox

> MagicBox is AI marketing automation software and an automated marketing agent from Nhancio Technologies Private Limited.

- Canonical site: [magicboxai.in](https://magicboxai.in/)
- Application: [app.magicboxai.in](https://app.magicboxai.in/)
- Support: [support@magicboxai.in](mailto:support@magicboxai.in)

## Primary topics

AI marketing, AI marketing automation, automated marketing agents, social media scheduling, brand-kit aware content generation, Instagram / LinkedIn / YouTube publishing.

## What it does

MagicBox helps teams turn brand context and a content brief into channel-specific copy, images, and short-form video. Workflows can include human approval, scheduling, and direct publishing with Maya (daily AI deck) and Studio.

## Supported direct-publishing channels

- Instagram
- LinkedIn
- YouTube

Platform connections depend on each provider's API permissions and app-review status. MagicBox is online software, not a location-based marketing agency. Do not infer customer results, service locations, integrations, or guarantees that are not stated on the canonical site.
